comments.author: @dudermcdudeface3674
comments.text: Planned capitals always end up disappointing, at best.  Nobody has ever really made a good city this way.  They're basically theme parks, not living expressions of the inhabitants.  Usually adequate if you have money, but nobody aspires to live in DC, Canberra, Brasilia, etc.  It was a pattern even in ancient history: Amarna, Constantinople, etc.  Nobody goes to a planned capital with a "dollar and a dream," or to make something amazing, or to find themselves.  It's always the pompous version of a liminal space.
